title: Diagonal completion of the normalized unit cocycle
statement: Under the hypotheses of the off-diagonal unit cocycle normalization, if d and a_i satisfy the normalization equation for every i != j, then the same equation holds for every diagonal pair i=i.

proof.text: Fix i and apply the given cocycle equation with all three indices equal to i and W = U_i ∩ U_i. The restrictions to W are identities. Thus t_ii squared equals t_ii; since t_ii is a unit, cancellation gives t_ii = 1.

Apply transitionUnit_mul_transitionUnit with all three indices equal to i. Restrict this equation from (U_i ∩ U_i) ∩ U_i back to U_i ∩ U_i, which is contained in that triple intersection. Each composite restriction is the identity by functoriality. This gives u_ii squared equals u_ii, and unit cancellation gives u_ii = 1.

Substitute the two diagonal identities. The restrictions of a_i along inf_le_left and inf_le_right are identical: these are morphisms between the same opens, in a preorder category. This proves the desired equality. No distinct-index equation or dimension bound is needed.

lean.statement: theorem standardUnitCocycle_diagonal_normalization (k : Type u) [Field k] (r : ℕ) (hr : 3 ≤ r) (t : ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r), Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k)), standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) i ⊓ standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) j)ˣ) (ht : ∀ (i j l : ULift.{u} (Fin r)) (W : ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k)).Opens) (hi : W ≤ standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) i) (hj : W ≤ standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) j) (hl : W ≤ standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) l), (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hi hj)).op (t i j).val * (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hj hl)).op (t j l).val = (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hi hl)).op (t i l).val) (d : ℤ) (a : ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin r), Γ(ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k)), standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) i)ˣ) (hoff : ∀ i j : ULift.{u} (Fin r), i ≠ j → (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (a i).val * (t i j).val = (transitionUnit _ (Spec (.of k)) d i j).val * (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (a j).val) : ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin r), (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (a i).val * (t i i).val = (transitionUnit _ (Spec (.of k)) d i i).val * (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin r); Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (a i).val
